the mid-wall lines are the most reproducible manual measurement method for SVI, while the computerized measurement based on vertebral body wall symmetry is the most reproducible method for SVI in MR images.

the mid-wall lines are the most reproducible manual measurement of SVI, and the computerized measurements are comparable in reproducibility and variability.
